work_history.job_title: Collaborating with others to meet mission requirements and accomplish objectives provided by the Northrop Grumman aerospace company.
description: Part of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Simulations Team constructing models of the UAVs in order to obtain important aerodynamic properties to perform flight test simulations.
Worked directly with the UAVs to take accurate measurements in order to model it.
Designed accurate aerodynamic models of the UAVs using the program AVL, a program for the aerodynamic and flight-dynamic analysis of rigid aircraft of arbitrary configuration.
Modeled all lifting surfaces, control surfaces, and fuselage.
Created data and run files of mass properties corresponding with each UAV.

work_history.job_title: Collaborating with a team to design and construct an aircraft that will be competing at the SAE Aero Design West.
description: Sanded the balsa wood wings smooth for the preparation of carbon fiber wrapping. Prepared the epoxy resin mixture for application.
Wrapped the leading edge, wing spars, fuselage molds, and fuselage walls with carbon fiber.

work_history.job_title: Performed as Team Leader for a team of four for the experimentation and analysis of flight dynamics and parameters of Lockheed Martin's F-22 Raptor.
description: Implemented low-speed wind and water tunnel testing using test models to obtain and investigate flight dynamics and performance characteristics. Analyzed the flow vortices over the wing at varying velocities at increasing angles of attacks.
Calculated and observed the relationship and importance of the effect of Reynold's numbers on aerodynamic coefficients.

work_history.job_title: Assist children in building and flying model aircraft, launch rockets, complete flight simulation missions, and conduct flight-related science experiments.
work_history.period: Company Name May 2013 to Current - Aviation Camp Assistant
description: Assist in teaching course lessons based on aviation, air, and space topics. Organize and prepare lesson materials and work directly with instructors during hands-on projects and activities.
Supervise elementary school-aged campers during sign-in, sign-out, and break times.

work_history.job_title: Offer superior service to potential and actual guests to the museum according to established procedures.
work_history.period: Company Name August 2012 to January 2013 - Guest Experiences Specialist
description: Handle a large volume of in-person questions about The Tech Museum, exhibits, programs, films, special events as well as the downtown San Jose area. Be knowledgeable about The Tech Museum's mission, programs and exhibits and stay current with the functioning of the entire institution.

matchmaking_summary: Highly motivated and results-oriented individual with a background in Aerospace Engineering, specializing in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and Aeronautical Development. Demonstrated expertise in designing aerodynamic models using AVL for flight test simulations, contributing to the F-22 Raptor project, and supervising educational activities for children in aviation camps. Proficient in MATLAB, C programming, and has strong collaboration skills from involvement with professional societies like AIAA and SAE.
